newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada July weekly earnings rise 2.4 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: Canada July weekly earnings rise 2.4 pct on year.

text.p: The preliminary estimate of average weekly earnings for Canadian workers in all industries except agriculture and fishing rose 2.4 percent in July from a year earlier to a seasonally adjusted C$584.85, Statistics Canada said on Thursday.
From the month before, earnings fell 0.7 percent.
Seasonally adjusted payroll employment rose 0.2 percent in July to 10.99 million from a revised 10.97 million in June.
A Reuter survey of economists had forecast that average weekly earnings would rise by 2.4 percent, year on year, after June's 2.8 percent rise.
